# Maider Barrutia — Frontend Developer & UI Specialist

> Professional portfolio of Maider Barrutia, a Frontend Developer and UI Specialist based in Madrid, Spain, specializing in React, TypeScript, Next.js, SCSS, UI/UX and AI-assisted development.

This portfolio showcases professional experience, technical skills, web development projects, education and certifications.

The website is bilingual: Spanish (es) and English (en), with Spanish as the default language.

## Technical Skills

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Vite, WordPress, Angular.
- Backend and databases: Node.js, Express, PHP, MySQL, Oracle.
- Design: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator.
- Testing: Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, TDD.
- Development tools: Git, Jira, Scrum, Kanban.
- AI-assisted development: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, OpenAI, Claude AI, OpenCode.

## Professional Experience

- Frontend Developer at Desarrollos Online (Madrid, 2025–Present): Full-stack corporate web applications, AI tool adoption, code refactoring and high-concurrency platforms.
- Freelance Frontend Developer (Remote, 2023–2025): Custom web applications, database architecture, REST APIs, UI/UX design and responsive interfaces.
- UI Developer at Corus Consulting (Madrid, 2017–2023): UI development for healthcare, banking, insurance and media clients, web performance optimization, security incident resolution and agile development.

## Featured Projects

- [Aisiplan — Live Demo](https://aisiplan.vercel.app): Full-stack leisure activity platform built with React, Vite, TypeScript, SASS, Node.js, Express, TypeORM, MySQL and JWT.
- [Aisiplan — Source Code](https://github.com/maiderbarrutia/fullstack-aisiplan): Full-stack application source code.
- [Web Development Portfolio](https://maiderbarrutia.com/proyectos): Additional projects including ecommerce, branding, corporate portals, AI platforms, real estate and digital healthcare.

## Additional Projects

- Ecommerce and Branding: WordPress and WooCommerce, multilingual implementation, art direction, packaging and custom child theme.
- Gas Corporate Portal: Multilingual energy company portal using WordPress, Elementor and custom SASS.
- AI Sales Simulator: Webflow implementation from Figma, custom CSS and JavaScript animations, and CMS integration.
- Real Estate Portal: WordPress frontend development using SASS, jQuery and PHP.
- Digital Health Portal: Custom WordPress theme for a healthcare community platform featuring videos, events and webinars.
